start.text: Day three. The malware is gone, the office is calm, and it is only 09:40. I should have known better.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Marta Silva, from Finance. All my files end in .locked, and there is a note on my screen asking for money! The month-end report is in there!
C.name: Marta

D1.text: A link? I... a parcel notice, this morning. It said my parcel could not be delivered. I clicked to choose a new date. Oh no.
D1.name: Marta

D2.text: Yes, but I unplugged the cable just now! Was that right? It said something about money, and I panicked.
D2.name: Marta

E.text: Unplugging was right. Do not pay, and do not touch anything. Paying promises nothing, and it only pays for the next attack.
E.name: Joshua

F.text: Please hurry. Everything for Friday is in there!
F.name: Marta

G.text: Every file, every copy and every message leaves a record somewhere. I only have to know where to look.
G.name: Joshua

H.text: [b][color=green]4 clues[/color][/b] should be enough to show what really happened. Then I put it in order.
H.name: Joshua
